verdict.rationale: First-party docs list "startup sessions to specify working environments" and "programmable tabs, splits and multiple layouts" as core features, and remote control lets scripts open windows. A hands-on probe confirmed scripted window and layout control (`kitten @ ls` returning layout state, plus sending text to a live window). missing for 10: detailed docs on session-file syntax and the single-command launch flow (e.g. a session flag), hands-on verification of a session file opening a full multi-tab/split workspace, and independent user corroboration of the sessions feature.
